text:
Mara Lin (eng-security): Intake from AcmeSec just dropped — attached report + evidence bundle. Quick summary: 2 x HIGH (auth bypass /api/sessions, KMS key access path via proxy), 6 x MED, logging gaps on a few internal services. Need: triage owners, retest window, and ops handoff. Who can take ownership?
Ajay Patel (eng-sre): I can own the KMS access path triage. Can you drop the exact repro steps or the PoC link?
Mara Lin (eng-security): PoC is in the evidence bundle: drive.google.com/acrobat/.. and presigned S3 at s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1752_acmesec.tar.gz (expires in 72h). Repro steps are short — see snippet in the bundle and quick notes below.
Claire Dobson (security-assessment): I'll coordinate with AcmeSec on retest criteria. Important: they want the same endpoints and account contexts for validation. Please don't rotate keys or change token TTLs until we agree.
Nina Gomez (eng-platform): For the auth bypass on /api/sessions, we should capture request/response traces and increase sampling to 100% for 30m. I can flip that but need an ops window that won't disrupt traffic. Propose: tomorrow 0900–1000 PT for trace and 1100–1200 PT for retest bridge?
Samir Rao (eng): FYI the affected service has replicas in Dedicated and Private clusters. Any RBAC change we test must be pushed to both. Who coordinates the Dedicated push?
Ajay Patel (eng-sre): I can push Dedicated once we have a patch. For RBAC: we should create ephemeral roles for assessors, limit scope to read-only logs and the specific service namespace. Ops-bot: create ephemeral role?
ops-bot: ephemeral-role created: pt-assessor-2024-08-12, expires 2024-08-12T15:00Z. Link: https://idp.local/roles/pt-assessor-2024-08-12 :white_check_mark:
Mara Lin (eng-security): Thanks. Two quick asks — 1) Can we enable KMS proxy audit logging for all Get* operations for the next 48h? 2) Who can produce a consolidated audit export (comma-separated list of operations + timestamps) for the windows in question?
Ajay Patel (eng-sre): I can turn on proxy debug/audit for KMS but want to throttle to avoid log explosion. Plan: enable detailed Get*/Decrypt traces for 48h, route to a dedicated S3 prefix and tag with pt-run-1748129999. I'll create a short lifecycle policy to expire after 90d.
Nina Gomez (eng-platform): I will run the audit export job — need the time window from you, and confirm S3 prefix. Also, we need to add a redact pass for any token blobs before handing to AcmeSec.
Claire Dobson (security-assessment): On retest acceptance criteria — we require PoC denied under same role set + evidence (request id, timestamp, response) for two consecutive runs. I'll publish an Eval card in the ticket.
Samir Rao (eng): Regarding RBAC changes: propose the following minimal change set: 1) deny anonymous fallback on session endpoint, 2) tighten assume-role for service accounts, 3) add conditional on source IP for KMS proxy. I'll open a PR and link it here.
Mara Lin (eng-security): Please link PRs to the PT ticket (PT-1129) and add labels: pt-remediate, needs-review, needs-retask.
Ajay Patel (eng-sre): PR: https://ghe.redwood/infra/infra/compare/PR-4286 — adds audit flag and KMS proxy conditional. I'll mark it hold until Claire signs off.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for PR-4286 to staging at 2024-08-12T07:45Z. Check: https://ci.redwood/pipeline/4286/status
Nina Gomez (eng-platform): For the retest phone bridge — propose 2024-08-12 11:30 PT (30m). Dial-in: +1 650 555 0123, pin 784512. Can everyone confirm availability?
Samir Rao (eng): Confirmed for 11:30.
Ajay Patel (eng-sre): Confirmed, will have audit exports ready by then.
Claire Dobson (security-assessment): Confirmed — I'll bring the retest checklist and acceptance criteria doc.
Mara Lin (eng-security): I'll run the vuln triage during the bridge and update PT-1129 with owners and remediation ETA.
Samir Rao (eng): Quick note — do not rotate the root KMS key until after the retest; we can rotate secondary keys after the patch.
Ajay Patel (eng-sre): Agreed. Also adding a short runbook snippet for the retest:
```
1) enable tracing for service A (Nina)
2) apply RBAC patch to staging (Samir)
3) export KMS proxy audit logs (Ajay)
4) hand evidence to Claire for acceptance
```
Mara Lin (eng-security): Who will package the evidence for the assessor? Need a sanitized bundle (no internal token values) + request/response pairs + timeline.
Nina Gomez (eng-platform): I'll prepare sanitized bundle. Deliverable: pt-1748129999-evidence-sanitized.tar.gz in s3://redwood-pt-evidence/sanitized/ with presigned link. ETA: 3h after staging deploy succeeds.
Ajay Patel (eng-sre): I will also attach the audit export CSV: redwood-kms-audit-1748129999.csv and push to same prefix.
Claire Dobson (security-assessment): Once evidence is uploaded, I'll coordinate a dry-run with AcmeSec on the bridge and confirm retest slots. If all green, they schedule validation and then we close PT-1129.
Mara Lin (eng-security): Perfect. Action items: Ajay (KMS audit + avoid rotation), Nina (tracing + sanitized bundle), Samir (RBAC PR + staging deploy), Claire (acceptance + retest criteria), Mara (triage owner + ticket updates).
Samir Rao (eng): I'll ping infra-checks to ensure Dedicated queue won't block the deploy.
Ajay Patel (eng-sre): Logging note: please include request-id header in all test repro steps — helps map traces to audit events.
Mara Lin (eng-security): Will do. Thanks team — see you on the 11:30 PT bridge. :thumbsup:
